bibliographic.title: Dreamworld Group Chat Game
bibliographic.author: Puka Muriska
bibliographic.genre: Surreal, dark, comedy, chat, imaginary world, dreams, liminal, labyrinth, absurd, nightmare,
bibliographic.description:
An absurd (sprinkled with horror) walking simulator but in chat format, to explore the Sand Castle, a surreal, labyrinthic building in my imaginary world, and meet the characters who live there.

This game is (I hope) 100% responsive and mobile friendly C:

This is still in development!!! For now, it only includes the castle’s ground floor and first basement. [2 out of 13 planned chapters finished!]

Controls: Click or tap anywhere on the screen to continue.

(Let me know if you find a bug or something I'm trying my best)
